meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: Claude 会先问你在做什么,再据此提议一套观察类型和概念标签,经你确认后安装并激活为 claude-mem 的自定义模式;可选配置 Telegram 提醒,重启 worker,并验证启动上下文里出现该模式。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记什么、新建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签等需求时触发,即使你没提到 “mode”。

say.text: 帮我建一个记录客户会议决策的模式
say.note: 它会先问你想记下什么

say.text: 给数据合同变更这类记忆加 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 需先有已连接的 Telegram 机器人

say.text: 把代码模式改成也记录实验结论和数据合同变更
say.note: 它会先提一套分类等你确认

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, then installs and activates them as a custom claude-mem mode. It can optionally add Telegram alerts, restart the worker, and verify startup context.
howto.when_en: Use when someone wants to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram alerts for memories — even without saying "mode".

say_en.text: Build a mode that records client meeting decisions
say_en.note: It asks what you want to remember

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts for data-contract change notes
Customize code mode to also log experiment results
